Notes

When using the 2020 ATUS data, researchers need to use the weighting variable TU20FWGT instead of TUFNWGTP. The usual final weight [TUFNWGTP] on the multiyear files will have missing values for cases with [TUYEAR = 2020] on the ATUS Respondent or Activity Summary file. Cases with [TUYEAR = 2019 or 2020] will have positive values for diary dates corresponding to January 1 - March 17 or May 10 - December 31. For more information about TU20FWGT, see chapter 7 of the ATUS User's Guide. Files: Respondent File, Activity Summary File (the dictionary's File column).
